page.title: Houston Improv — Shows, Tickets & Info
page.meta_title: Houston Improv — Shows, Tickets & Info | Comedy Houston
page.meta_description: Upcoming shows at the Houston Improv with prices and direct ticket links, updated twice daily — plus location and venue info for Houston's biggest comedy club.
page.description_html:
The Houston Improv is the city's stop on the nationwide Improv comedy club circuit, located at 7620 Katy Fwy #431 in the Marq*E entertainment district on the Katy Freeway. It's the room where the biggest national touring headliners play when they come through Houston — the calendar below regularly features comics you know from Netflix specials, late-night TV, and the big podcasts, often for multi-night weekend runs with early and late shows.

Tickets for most shows are sold through Ticketmaster and the club's box office, and headliner weekends sell out routinely — if a Friday or Saturday name show is on your list, book early rather than at the door.

page.title: Punch Line Houston — Shows, Tickets & Info
page.meta_title: Punch Line Houston — Shows, Tickets & Info | Comedy Houston
page.meta_description: Upcoming shows at Punch Line Comedy Club Houston in the Galleria — national headliners and Spanish-language nights, with prices and direct ticket links.
page.description_html:
Punch Line Houston is a dedicated stand-up club at 2930 Sage Rd in the Galleria area, and one of the busiest rooms in the city — most weeks it runs shows Wednesday through Sunday, mixing national touring headliners with strong club regulars and Spanish-language shows (look for the "en Español" listings). It's the kind of room where you can catch a Daily Show correspondent on Friday and a rising club comic finding their hour on Sunday.

Tickets are sold through Ticketmaster; weekend headliner shows frequently sell out, and seating is typically assigned at the door by arrival time.

page.title: The Secret Group — Shows, Tickets & Info
page.meta_title: The Secret Group — Shows, Tickets & Info | Comedy Houston
page.meta_description: Upcoming comedy at The Secret Group in EaDo Houston — alternative touring comics, showcases, and open mics with prices and ticket links, updated twice daily.
page.description_html:
The Secret Group is an independent comedy venue and bar at 2101 Polk St in EaDo (East Downtown), and the center of gravity for Houston's alternative comedy scene. Across its rooms you'll find touring alt-comedy and podcast acts, local showcases, themed shows, and some of the most consistent open mics in the city — there's comedy on the calendar most nights of the week.

The venue also hosts non-comedy nights (music, karaoke, dance parties); we filter those out automatically, so the list below is only the comedy. Tickets for most shows are sold through Eventbrite, and plenty of the weekly programming is cheap or free.

page.meta_description: Upcoming shows from The Riot Comedy Club — now at a new home on Washington Ave in Houston — weekend headliner showcases with prices and direct ticket links.
page.description_html:
The Riot Comedy Club has relocated to a new home at 1925 Washington Ave in Houston, moving on from its long run in the upstairs room at Rudyard's in Montrose. (The Riot also runs a separate room in Conroe — see The Riot Comedy Club — Conroe.) Its bread and butter is tightly-booked weekend headliner showcases — touring comics with credits like Kill Tony, Don't Tell Comedy, and late-night TV, backed by strong Houston openers.

Tickets are sold through Eventbrite and the shows are intimate by design, so popular weekends genuinely do sell out. The Riot also produces occasional shows at other Houston venues — those appear in our listings under the venue actually hosting them.

page.description_html:
The Riot Comedy Club's Conroe location runs inside GuadalaHARRY's at 219 Simonton St in Conroe, TX, bringing the club's headliner comedy north of Houston. Like the flagship room, it books tightly-curated weekend showcases of touring comics backed by strong Houston-area openers.

Tickets are sold through Eventbrite, and the room doubles as a full-service Tex-Mex restaurant, so you can grab food and drinks with the show.

page.title: The Den Comedy Club — Shows, Tickets & Info
page.meta_title: The Den Comedy Club Houston — Shows, Tickets & Info | Comedy Houston
page.meta_description: The Den Comedy Club: Houston's speakeasy stand-up room inside Wolfsmiths in Lindale Park. Real cocktails, no drink minimum, shows Thursday to Saturday. Every date, price, and ticket link, updated daily.
page.description_html:
The Den Comedy Club is Houston's speakeasy comedy room: a hidden stand-up club tucked above Wolfsmiths, the cafe and cocktail bar at 201 Woodard St in Lindale Park, one neighborhood over from the Heights. There is no sign outside. You walk into Wolfsmiths, look for the white orchids, and slip into a room built with wood accents, soft lighting, and seats close enough that every show feels like a private set.

The club opened in March 2026 and is owned by working Houston comedians Janan Araujo-Siam and Onkar Singh, which shapes everything about it. Lineups are curated showcases of the city's best working comics with touring guests mixed in: the kind of bill a comic books to impress other comics, performed for a crowd that found the room on purpose. The space is small enough that shows regularly sell out on word of mouth alone.

The Den vs. Houston Improv vs. Punch Line: which club for which night?

The Houston Improv is the national-headliner room: names you know from Netflix playing multi-night weekend runs at the Marq*E center on the Katy Freeway, with big-club pricing and the standard two-item minimum. Punch Line Houston is the classic club in the middle: strong touring headliners, 18 and up, two-beverage minimum per person. Both are reliable nights out, and if the goal is seeing someone you already know from TV, that is where they will be.

The Den is the other kind of great night. You may not recognize the names on the lineup yet, and that is the point: this is where Houston's best working comics do their sharpest sets in a room small enough to hear the table next to you lose it. Tickets usually cost less than parking near the big clubs, and the intimacy does the rest. Ask a Houston comic where they would take a date to watch stand-up and The Den comes up more often than any room its size should.

Food and drinks: Wolfsmiths downstairs, and no drink minimum

Because The Den lives upstairs from Wolfsmiths, you get real food and real cocktails with table service during the show: a full menu from the kitchen, drinks built by the house mixologist, plus wine, beer, and non-alcoholic options. And unlike the big clubs, The Den does not lean on a drink minimum. Order because the cocktails are good, not because the fine print says two items. Come early, eat downstairs, then head up for the show.

Know before you go

  • Where: 201 Woodard St, Houston, TX 77009, inside Wolfsmiths in Lindale Park, minutes from the Heights.
  • Finding it: no signage. Enter Wolfsmiths and look for the white orchids.
  • Show nights: Thursday through Saturday, with specials in between.
  • Tickets: sold through Eventbrite; every upcoming date is listed below with prices and direct links.
  • Follow the club: thedencomedyclub.com and @thedencomedyclub.

Every show at The Den appears in the listings below automatically, updated twice a day, alongside every other comedy show in Houston. If it is on sale, it is here.
